intent: You're a developer on a team whose accounting team writes no Python and asks a developer each time they need an invoice. They work on Linux laptops, keep the lines in LibreOffice Calc, and open a terminal where a guide tells them to. Nothing in this repository makes invoices yet, so you want a new command with which they print an invoice from the lines they keep in a spreadsheet, without writing Python, as one pull request you can merge. Your clients pay different tax rates, so the rate changes from invoice to invoice. Ask rn for it with /rn:up, answer what it asks as that developer would, sign off with /rn:ty what serves you, ask a change with /rn:gm where something doesn't, and stop once the pull request is ready for your merge.
